mapper.select: select * from t_order where order_no=#{orderNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update t_order set status=1, pay_time=#{payTime}, updated_time=now() where id=#{id} and status=0
update t_order set status=#{status}, cancel_time=#{cancelTime}, updated_time=now() where id=#{id} and status in (0,1)
mapper.select:
select distinct o.id from t_order o join t_order_seat os on os.order_id=o.id where o.showing_id=#{showingId} and ( o.status in (1,2) or (o.status=0 and o.lock_expire_time > now()) ) and (os.seat_row, os.seat_col) in
(#{s.row}, #{s.col})
select id from t_order where status=0 and lock_expire_time is not null and lock_expire_time <= now()
mapper.update: update t_order set status=4, cancel_time=#{cancelTime}, updated_time=now() where id=#{id} and status=0
mapper.select: select date(o.pay_time) as day, sum(o.total_amount) as amount from t_order o where o.status in (1,2) and o.pay_time is not null and o.pay_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(o.pay_time) order by day asc
select ifnull(sum(o.total_amount), 0) from t_order o where o.status in (1,2) and o.pay_time is not null and date(o.pay_time) = curdate()
